Job 90403 on controller west failed in the task "Apply the base workload" with:

    ERROR! the role 'agnosticd.core_workloads.base' was not found in /runner/project/roles or /runner/project

The job template resolves to the catalog item sandboxes-gpte.ans-bu-wksp-rhel-90, which the catalog lookup places in agnosticd/agnosticd-v2; The reason is in the execution environment's Ansible configuration. agnosticd/agnosticd-v2:ansible.cfg sets

    collections_path = /runner/project/collections

and nothing else. Dynamically installed collections land in /runner/requirements_collections, which that path does not include, so even when agnosticd.core_workloads is installed for the run Ansible never looks where it was put and the role resolves to nothing.

The fix is to widen collections_path so it includes /runner/requirements_collections alongside the project directory.

Root cause category: dependency. Confidence: high.
